UPDATE room_playback_state
            SET playing_media_id = NULL,
                playing_playlist_id = NULL,
                target = NULL,
                current_progress_id = NULL,
                speed = 1.0,
                is_playing = FALSE,
                playback_generation = playback_generation + 1,
                version = version + 1,
                updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            WHERE playing_media_id = ANY($1)
